_comment: Hand-curated model entries for direct-API providers that the upstream model-catalog source does not carry (Voyage AI's direct API today, others later). Merged into llmModels at module load — see loadModelCatalog.ts. The base llmModels.json is regenerated periodically and overwriting hand-added entries would silently drop these providers; the overlay file is never touched by the regen task. Add entries here when integrating a provider whose models aren't reachable via the upstream catalog. Audio entries here are the ones litellm's price registry cannot serve correctly: models it lacks (ElevenLabs flash/turbo, gpt-transcribe), models it prices without audio units (gpt-4o-mini-tts, the gpt-4o transcribe pair), and models where its rate lags a provider price change (eleven_multilingual_v2 still carries the pre-cut rate upstream). `loadModelCatalog.ts` is the authority for merge precedence: it applies the regenerated base `llmModels.json` first and this hand-curated overlay second, so an overlay entry wins when both catalogs contain the same key. Overlay entries are corrections and overrides, not fallback-only entries, and must be retired when the upstream catalog is corrected. Entries litellm carries correctly (tts-1, tts-1-hd, whisper-1, scribe_v1) were retired from the overlay and flow in via the weekly sync.

voyage/voyage-3.5.name: Voyage AI: Voyage 3.5
voyage/voyage-3.5.description: Voyage AI's flagship general-purpose embedding model with strong retrieval quality across domains.

voyage/voyage-3.5-lite.name: Voyage AI: Voyage 3.5 Lite
voyage/voyage-3.5-lite.description: Voyage AI's smaller, faster embedding model. Lower cost per token at a modest quality tradeoff, useful for high-volume topic-clustering workloads.

openai_codex/gpt-5.6-terra.name: Codex: GPT-5.6 Terra
openai_codex/gpt-5.6-terra.description: OpenAI's flagship coding model, billed to your ChatGPT plan. Zero token cost: usage counts against your subscription limits instead.

openai_codex/gpt-5.6-sol.name: Codex: GPT-5.6 Sol
openai_codex/gpt-5.6-sol.description: Balanced coding model on your ChatGPT plan. Zero token cost: usage counts against your subscription limits instead.

openai_codex/gpt-5.6-luna.name: Codex: GPT-5.6 Luna
openai_codex/gpt-5.6-luna.description: Fast, lighter coding model on your ChatGPT plan. Zero token cost: usage counts against your subscription limits instead.

openai/gpt-4o-mini-tts.name: OpenAI: GPT-4o mini TTS
openai/gpt-4o-mini-tts.description: OpenAI speech synthesis on the GPT-4o mini engine. Priced per input character, derived from OpenAI's published $0.015-per-minute estimate at a standard speech rate.

openai/gpt-4o-transcribe.name: OpenAI: GPT-4o Transcribe
openai/gpt-4o-transcribe.description: OpenAI speech-to-text on the GPT-4o engine. Billed per token, $2.50 per million audio input tokens and $10.00 per million output tokens (https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-4o-transcribe, verified 2026-08-15). The $0.006-per-minute figure OpenAI publishes next to it is an estimate derived from those token rates, not a second billing basis, so this entry carries no per-second rate: the response reports tokens and no duration, and pricing both would charge the same audio twice. The audio rate matches the text input rate today; it is stated so the audio split prices correctly if OpenAI ever separates them. gpt-4o-transcribe-diarize prefix-matches this entry and carries the same published rates.

openai/gpt-4o-mini-transcribe.name: OpenAI: GPT-4o mini Transcribe
openai/gpt-4o-mini-transcribe.description: OpenAI speech-to-text on the GPT-4o mini engine. Billed per token, $1.25 per million audio input tokens and $5.00 per million output tokens (https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-4o-mini-transcribe, verified 2026-08-15). Same reasoning as gpt-4o-transcribe: the published $0.003 per minute is an estimate, the response reports tokens, so there is no per-second rate here.

openai/gpt-transcribe.name: OpenAI: GPT Transcribe
openai/gpt-transcribe.description: OpenAI's duration-priced speech-to-text model, $0.0045 per minute (https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-transcribe, verified 2026-08-15), which is $7.5e-5 per second. Unlike the gpt-4o transcribe pair it reports usage as a duration and OpenAI publishes no token rate for it, so seconds are the only basis. It routes through the gateway today and had no catalog entry at all, so every call billed zero.

openai/gpt-realtime-translate.name: OpenAI: GPT Realtime Translate
openai/gpt-realtime-translate.description: Live translation, priced by duration at $0.034 per minute (https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing, verified 2026-08-15). Its own entry because the prefix-anchored match sent it to gpt-realtime, whose $32-per-million audio token rate has nothing to do with a per-minute live model. The gateway serves no realtime socket today, so this entry is a guard against the wrong rate rather than a rate in use.

openai/gpt-live-transcribe.name: OpenAI: GPT Live Transcribe
openai/gpt-live-transcribe.description: Live transcription, priced by duration at $0.017 per minute (https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing, verified 2026-08-15). It matched nothing in the catalog before. Its sibling gpt-realtime-whisper already carries the same rate in the base catalog. The gateway serves no realtime socket today.

elevenlabs/eleven_multilingual_v2.name: ElevenLabs: Multilingual v2
elevenlabs/eleven_multilingual_v2.description: ElevenLabs' quality-tier speech synthesis. Priced per input character ($0.10 per 1k characters).

elevenlabs/eleven_flash_v2.name: ElevenLabs: Flash v2
elevenlabs/eleven_flash_v2.description: ElevenLabs' low-latency speech synthesis. Priced per input character ($0.05 per 1k characters).

elevenlabs/eleven_flash_v2_5.name: ElevenLabs: Flash v2.5
elevenlabs/eleven_flash_v2_5.description: ElevenLabs' low-latency multilingual speech synthesis. Priced per input character ($0.05 per 1k characters).

openai/gpt-realtime.name: OpenAI: GPT Realtime
openai/gpt-realtime.description: OpenAI's speech-to-speech realtime model. Audio tokens cost eight times text tokens ($32 against $4 per million in, $64 against $16 out), so the audio split has to be priced apart. Rates from https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing (verified 2026-08-14). The cached-token rate here is the text one; a cached audio token is $0.40 per million on this model, the same figure.

openai/gpt-realtime-mini.name: OpenAI: GPT Realtime mini
openai/gpt-realtime-mini.description: The smaller speech-to-speech realtime model. Its own entry because the prefix-anchored match would otherwise price it at the full gpt-realtime rate, roughly three times higher on audio. Rates from https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing (verified 2026-08-14). The cached-token rate here is the text one ($0.06 per million); a cached audio token is $0.30 per million.

elevenlabs/convai.name: ElevenLabs: Conversational AI
elevenlabs/convai.description: ElevenLabs conversational agents, priced by conversation duration at $0.08 per minute (https://elevenlabs.io/pricing/api, verified 2026-08-14). The figure is per second, $0.08 divided by 60. LLM cost is not included in it.

elevenlabs/eleven_turbo_v2_5.name: ElevenLabs: Turbo v2.5
elevenlabs/eleven_turbo_v2_5.description: ElevenLabs' balanced quality/latency speech synthesis. Priced per input character ($0.05 per 1k characters).

openai/gpt-audio-mini.name: OpenAI: GPT Audio Mini
openai/gpt-audio-mini.description: A cost-efficient version of GPT Audio. Text input and output are priced by the fields above. Audio input is priced by audioCostPerToken, and the cost layer derives the audio output rate as twice the audio input rate. Rates verified 2026-08-15 on https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing, which lists audio input $10.00 and audio output $20.00 per million for this model. Note the per-model page at /api/docs/models/gpt-audio-mini carries the text rates only, so the pricing page is the source for the audio side. This entry exists because one upstream source reports the audio input rate as the text rate, which billed audio at a sixteenth of the published price. The other source carries the correct rate. Retire this entry once the wrong source is corrected; the weekly price audit reports the disagreement until then.

openai/gpt-realtime-2.name: OpenAI: GPT Realtime 2
openai/gpt-realtime-2.description: OpenAI's realtime speech model, second generation. Text input $4.00, text output $24.00, audio input $32.00 and audio output $64.00 per million tokens, with cached input at $0.40 (https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-realtime-2, verified 2026-08-16). This entry exists for the text output rate only: the price registry the sync imports from carries $16.00 there, which is the previous generation's rate and a third under what the provider charges. Every other rate here matches that registry. Retire this entry once the registry is corrected; the weekly price audit reports the disagreement until then.

openai/o3-deep-research.name: OpenAI: o3 Deep Research
openai/o3-deep-research.description: Delisted from the model catalog source on 2026-08-16 while still live. Input $10.00 and output $40.00 per million, cached input $2.50 (https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/o3-deep-research, verified 2026-08-16, not marked deprecated). Without this entry it prefix-matches openai/o3 and bills 80 percent under.

openai/o4-mini-deep-research.name: OpenAI: o4 Mini Deep Research
openai/o4-mini-deep-research.description: Delisted from the model catalog source on 2026-08-16. The second price source still carries $2.00 input and $8.00 output per million, matching what this catalog held before the delisting. Without this entry it prefix-matches openai/o4-mini and bills 45 percent under.

openai/gpt-5.3-chat.name: OpenAI: GPT-5.3 Chat
openai/gpt-5.3-chat.description: Delisted from the model catalog source on 2026-08-16. The second price source still carries $1.75 input and $14.00 output per million, matching what this catalog held before. Without this entry it prefix-matches openai/gpt-5 and bills 29 percent under.

mistralai/devstral-2512.name: Mistral: Devstral 2 2512
mistralai/devstral-2512.description: Delisted from the model catalog source on 2026-08-16. The second price source still carries $0.40 input and $2.00 output per million, matching what this catalog held before. Without this entry no rule matches it at all and it bills zero.

poolside/laguna-m.1.name: Poolside: Laguna M.1
poolside/laguna-m.1.description: Delisted from the model catalog source on 2026-08-16 and absent from the second source, so these are the rates this catalog itself carried on 2026-07-27, kept so the model bills something rather than zero. No source can confirm them now. Retire this entry once the model is known to be gone, or correct it once a source carries it again.
